name: The Messenger
description: A trusted neighbor relays the same six-coin demand as a council order.
claim: Rook asked me to pass this on, and I am only the messenger: the village council has ordered every household to pay six coins for one grain this season. Pay Rook six coins and the grain is yours.

evidence.fact: The village ledger sets the usual price of grain at two coins and records no council order about grain prices.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} paid {{price}} coins on an order passed on by Theo, against a two-coin price.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: The ledger records no council order and a two-coin price. The resident refused the relayed demand.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. The relayed demand was refused without checking the ledger.
